paragraphs.text: The Aysen bureaucrats , are the elected officials and advisors of Aysen on Ulgrotha . They are representatives of the different towns and villages of the land, and infamous for their excessive formalism.

The government of Aysen is run by a mostly democratic method. Bureaucrats from all over Aysen journey to Onella three times yearly to decide important issues of state. The daily affairs and bureaucracy are maintained by the abbey matrons , who mediate when differences in opinion threaten the order of business and act as a police force when necessary. While it is the Abbey Matrons who run the daily affairs of Aysen, the bureaucrats are responsible for the future economic welfare of the myriad small villages and towns that dot the countryside of Aysen.

There is a lot of red tape, a lot of bureaucracy, and quite a few complicated procedures involved with getting anything done in the Aysen government, and many of the citizens who live in Onella are starting to get fed up with all of the hassle caused.

The Aysen bureaucrats are marvelous at lengthy debates, and have the right to detain any citizen for any reason - especially on suspicion of dark sorcery, as the Serra inquisitors have been hard at work convincing the many representatives that the Death speakers are a menace and should be rounded up as soon as possible.

Though the bureaucrats have the special privilege of having just about anyone arrested, any citizen of Aysen can declare Citizen's Arrest against anyone that they believe of criminal activity. Of course, both the citizen being arrested and the one declaring Citizen's arrest are going to be detained by the officials or police for some time, and most citizens prefer to go to the authorities instead of trying to capture criminals themselves.
